title: 45 Erupting Volcanoes Hide A Concentrated Global Threat
hook: Earth's volcanic danger is clustered closer together than it looks.
closing: Where volcanoes cluster matters because nearby communities share the same concentrated risk.
question: Do you live near a volcano?

segments.say: About 45 volcanoes are erupting now. Earth's interior stays active even when headlines are quiet.
75 percent of active volcanoes sit on the Pacific Ring of Fire. Much of the danger circles one ocean.
Only 16 are designated Decade Volcanoes. Scientists focus attention where eruptions could threaten nearby communities most.
